svg.desc: 24,679 GitHub contributions across 168 active days, 2025-11-09 to 2026-11-14. An automatically played breakout animation. Stronger contribution levels take more hits. A long streak unlocks multiball. The original calendar returns each loop.

g.text: Built one day at a time.
